welcome.heading: Dear expert,
body: Welcome, and thank you for taking part in this survey! Your participation will help us validate the results of a text classification model that assigns numerical scores to a series of statements. These scores indicate the degree to which each text aligns with specific predefined categories.

In this survey, you will be asked to assess the scores of four texts. The scores range from 0 to 100, where 0 means the texts reflect a maximally illiberal position and 100 maximally liberal position.
Your expert judgment will be essential to evaluate the accuracy of the model and improve its performance in future analyses. We greatly appreciate your time and valuable input.

definition.heading: Questionnaire Instructions
intro: The texts in this questionnaire have been assigned a score ranging from 0 to 100 by our text classification tool according to the following question:.
To what extent this text clearly shows commitment to free and fair elections with multiple parties, freedom of speech, media, assembly and association?

cards.title: Support for liberal democracy
cards.body: Texts show full commitment to key democratic principles if they unambiguously support freedom of speech, media, assembly and association and pledge to accept defeat in free and fair elections and would receive a score of 100.

cards.title: No support for liberal democracy
cards.body: Text shows no commitment to such principles if they openly support an autocratic form of government without elections or freedom of speech, assembly and association (e.g. theocracy; single-party rule; revolutionary regime) and would receive a score of 0.

outro: The positions of the sliders on the following page are aligned to our model outputs, please re-align as you see fit. Thank you!

items.text: A prerequisite for a well-functioning democracy is an electoral system that ensures that voters are able to express their preferences in terms of both policies and people.

This is why I think we should not be afraid to go against the spirit of the age and build an illiberal political and state system.

It is important to stand up for what we believe in. Freedom, respect for the dignity of all human beings, and respect for the rule of law, the equality of men and women - these are fundamental values that guide us, and without which social solidarity is unthinkable.

The argument we can provide to support our assertion that there is an absence of democracy is that in Western Europe censorship and restrictions on freedom of speech have become general phenomena. Working together, political leaders and technology giants filter news items that are uncomfortable for the liberal elite.

The liberal concept of freedom of opinion has gone so far that liberals see diversity of opinion as important up until the point that they realise, to their shock, that there are opinions which are different from theirs.

There are three key notions in the current transformation of the Hungarian political system,. The rule of law, the Constitution, and the rights of man. Together, these represent nothing less than the disintegration of an authoritarian and bureaucratic system and the transition toward a pluralist and democratic system.
